## About
Mirek's European Auto is an independent body and auto repair shop in Oldsmar, in the Tampa Bay area. We do collision and body work and mechanical repairs in the same building, so one shop can handle the whole job.
We specialize in European cars like Porsche, Mercedes, Audi, BMW and Volkswagen, and domestic cars are no problem. When you call, you'll talk with Mirek or Janina. Reviewers mention Kamil by name for honest, thorough work.
We use quality paints and parts and good shop equipment to do the job right. Customers rate us 4.6 on Google from 81 reviews.

## Services
- Collision and body work: Certified collision and body repair, from bumpers to bigger jobs.
- Mechanical service: The mechanical side of your car, handled in the same shop as your body work.
- European cars: Our specialty: Porsche, Mercedes, Audi, BMW and Volkswagen.
- Domestic cars: Not driving a European car? Bring it in anyway.
- Paint and body restorations: Full paint and body restoration work.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in European cars such as Porsche, Mercedes, Audi, BMW and Volkswagen, and we work on domestic cars as well.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're closed Saturday and Sunday and open on weekdays.

Q: How do I set up an appointment?
A: Call us at 813-891-9118 and we'll get you on the schedule.
